SUMMARY: This factory builds an L-shaped indoor staircase: two straight flights joined at a right-angle landing/platform, with steps, treads, side stringers, handrails, posts, rails, and optional bars/glass infill. `l_shaped.py` subclasses `StraightStaircaseFactory` (in `straight.py`), overriding the geometry-generating methods (line paths, post locations, steps, treads, sides) to add the mid-flight turn and landing platform; all randomized sizes/materials/support styles are inherited from the straight-staircase base. (Note: the "woolly mammoth" request text is unrelated to this staircase asset.)

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/elements/staircases/__init__.py
  random_staircase_factory: picks a staircase type at random.
    knobs: door_probs([2,2,2,0.5,2,2] for Straight/L/U/Spiral/Curved/Cantilever) -> relative selection probability of each staircase style (Spiral rarest).

FILE: assets/objects/elements/staircases/l_shaped.py
  LShapedStaircaseFactory.__init__: sets the turn point and rail style for the L shape.
    knobs: self.m = int(self.n * uniform(0.4,0.6)) -> step index where the flight turns 90°, i.e. length of first flight vs second (randomly sampled); is_rail_circular(True, fixed) -> forces round rail cross-section.
  make_line / make_line_offset: builds the L-shaped centerline path (first flight along +y, second flight along -x after the landing). Geometry only; edit to reshape turn/landing offset.
  make_post_locs / make_vertical_post_locs: choose handrail post positions along the L path, inserting extra posts (post_k+1/+2 spacing) around the turn (indices m-1,m,m+1).
  make_steps: rotates steps after index m by 90° and adds a solid landing `platform` cube.
    knobs: platform.scale = (step_width/2, step_width/2, (step_height*m - lowest)/2) -> landing footprint & height (derived from inherited step dims).
  make_treads: rotates treads past the turn and adds a landing tread slab.
    knobs: platform.scale z = tread_height/2 -> landing tread thickness.
  make_inner_sides: rotates side stringers past turn; cuts first-flight sides at landing height with top_cutter (scale [100]*3, fixed large).
  make_outer_sides: offsets outer stringers by step_width and builds an L-corner outer side wall extruded down by side_height, solidified by side_thickness.
  upper (property): returns np.pi -> valid door/placement orientation range for the L layout (base class uses ±pi/2).

FILE: assets/objects/elements/staircases/straight.py  (base class; controls nearly all tunables)
  StraightStaircaseFactory.support_types: weighted style of load-bearing structure.
    knobs: weights (single-rail 2, double-rail 2, side 3, solid 3, hole 3) -> which support geometry (rails vs side stringers vs solid/pierced slab) is used.
  handrail_types: weighted handrail infill style.
    knobs: weights (glass 2, horizontal-post 2, vertical-post 2) -> glass panels vs horizontal bars vs vertical balusters.
  __init__ (sampled randomly per seed):
    knobs: hole_size(log_uniform 0.6-1.0) -> size of pierced hole under steps; rail_offset(step_width*uniform 0.15-0.3) -> inset of rails from edge; is_rail_circular(<0.5) -> round vs box rail; rail_width(log_uniform 0.08-0.2), rail_height(log_uniform 0.08-0.12) -> rail cross-section; has_tread(0.75 prob) -> whether treads exist; tread_height(0.01-0.02 solid / 0.06-0.08 open), tread_length(step_length+0.01-0.02), tread_width(step_width+0.01-0.02 with 0.8 prob) -> tread slab dims; side_type(zig-zag/straight) -> stringer profile; side_height(step_height*log_uniform 0.2-0.8), side_thickness(uniform 0.03-0.08) -> stringer size; is_handrail_circular(<0.7) -> round vs box handrail; handrail_width/height(log_uniform 0.02-0.06), handrail_offset(width*log_uniform 1-2), handrail_extension(0.1-0.2) -> handrail cross-section/overhang; post_height(log_uniform 0.8-1.2) -> baluster/handrail height; post_k(ceil(step_width/step_length)) -> post spacing density; post_width(handrail_width*log_uniform 0.6-0.8), post_minor_width(post_width*log_uniform 0.3-0.5), is_post_circular(<0.5) -> post size/shape; bar_size(log_uniform 0.1-0.2), n_bars(floor(post_height/bar_size*uniform 0.35-0.75)) -> horizontal bar count/spacing; glass_height(post_height-uniform 0-0.05), glass_margin(step_height/2+uniform 0-0.05) -> glass panel extents; mirror(<0.5) -> left/right handedness; rot_z(randint(4)*pi/2) -> whole-asset yaw; end_margin(step_length*8) -> placeholder run-off length.
  build_size_config: overall stair sizing.
    knobs: n(randint 13-21) -> number of steps; step_height(wall_height/n) -> riser (from RoomConstants.wall_height); step_width(uniform 0.8-1.6) -> stair width; step_length(step_height*log_uniform 0.8-1.2) -> tread run.
  make_rails/make_treads/make_inner_sides/make_outer_sides/make_handrails/make_posts/make_bars/make_glasses: geometry builders for each part (edit to change part shapes).
  finalize_assets: assigns materials per tagged part (steps/treads/rails/sides/handrails/posts/glasses) sampled from material_assignments.
  make_guardrail / decorate_line / create_placeholder / create_cutter: room-integration geometry & wall cutting (advanced; edit only to change how the staircase carves/attaches to rooms).
  lower/upper/valid_contour: orientation range & door-visibility validation used during placement.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/objects/elements/__init__.py -> re-exports element factories (doors, pillars, rugs, staircases, warehouses).
  assets/composition/material_assignments.py -> pools of materials (step/rail/tread/side/handrail/post/glasses) sampled for surfaces.
  assets/utils/decorate.py -> mesh helpers: read_co/write_co, write_attribute, mirror, remove_faces/vertices, subsurf.
  assets/utils/mesh.py -> line/linestring conversion & canonicalization utilities.
  assets/utils/nodegroup.py -> geo_radius node group giving lines a tube cross-section.
  assets/utils/object.py -> primitive object creators (new_cube, new_line, new_circle, mesh2obj, join_objects, separate_loose).
  assets/utils/shapes.py -> cut_polygon_by_line for slicing step/side polygons.
  core/constraints/constraint_language/constants.py -> RoomConstants (wall_height, wall_thickness, door_size) driving stair scale.
  core/nodes/* -> Nodes/NodeWrangler geometry-node API used by geo_extrude/geo_radius.
  core/placement/detail.py -> sharp_remesh_with_attrs remeshing for the wall guardrail.
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base (seeding, create_asset/placeholder interface).
  core/surface.py -> material assignment, add_geomod, attribute read/write.
  core/tagging.py, core/tags.py -> face-tag PREFIX and Subpart tags (Wall/Ceiling/Visible/etc.).
  core/util/blender.py -> Blender op wrappers (modify_mesh, ViewportMode, apply_transform, delete).
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed, normalize.
  core/util/random.py -> log_uniform, weighted_sample, random_general (rg) samplers.
  assets/__init__.py, assets/utils/__init__.py, core/__init__.py, core/nodes/__init__.py, core/util/__init__.py, core/util/logging.py, core/nodes/node_info.py -> package init/logging/node metadata.
